chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umeyr, from one of his companions, who said:

A man sneezed in the presence of Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him), so he said, 'The Praise is for Allah,' but Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) did not respond with 'Yarhamuk Allah' and said: 'You have been deficient of our rights.'
Then he (peace be upon him) said: 'Whenever one of you sneezes, let him say, "The Praise is for Allah, Lord of the worlds, and may Allah send Salawat upon Muhammad and the People of his Household."'
He said: So the man said it, and Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) responded by naming Allah (Yarhamuk Allah).

key_terms.يُسَمِّتْهُ: To respond with 'Yarhamuk Allah' (May Allah have mercy on you)

ai.seo_question: What is the complete formula for responding to a sneeze in Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: This narration from al-Kafi highlights the Shia emphasis on integrating divine praise with specific invocation of the Prophet and Ahl al-Bayt during daily acts like sneezing. It illustrates the Imam's role in correcting ritual etiquette, linking the completeness of the praise ('Alhamdulillah') to the spiritual right of the Imam to be remembered, thereby elevating the act from mere social courtesy to a devotional practice. This reflects the broader Shia scholarly view that proper acknowledgment of the Prophet's household is integral to the perfection of worship.

en.hubeali: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from one of his companions who said,

‘A man sneezed in the presence of Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup>, so he said, ‘The Praise is for Allah<sup>azwj</sup>’, so Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> did not respond (Allah<sup>azwj</sup>) and said: ‘You have been deficient of our<sup>asws</sup> rights’.

Then heasws said: ‘Whenever one of you sneezes, so let him say, ‘The Praise is for Allahazwj, Lordazwj of the worlds, and may Allahazwj Send Salawāt upon Muhammadsaww and the Progenyasws of Muhammadsaww, and the Peopleasws of hissaww Household’.
So the man said it, and Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> responded (by Naming Allah<sup>azwj</sup>)’.
en.sarwar: 9. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from certain individuals of his people from who has said the following: “
Once a man sneezed in the presence of abu Ja’far (a.s.) and he said, ‘All praise belongs to Allah.’ Abu Ja’far (a.s.) did not respond and said, ‘Our rights are reduced.’

Then he said, ‘Whenever anyone of you sneezes he should say, “All praise belongs to Allah, Lord of the worlds and Allah has granted al- Salat (favors) upon Muhammad and the AM al-Bay (family of Muhammad).”’
The narrator has said that the man then said it and abu Ja’far (a.s.) responded.’”
